# RPG UI Pack Import

Source: `C:\Users\dovig\Downloads\rpg-ui-pack`
License basis: project owner reports this pack was purchased via Humble Bundle.
Runtime status: staged reference material only; not authoritative UI theme by default.

Imported for Gallicus use:
- `ui_assets_1x.png`, `ui_assets_2x.png`, `ui_assets_3x.png`: candidate atlas sheets for future icons, settings controls, sliders, small UI states.
- `reference_sheet.png`: visual index for slicing/selection.
- `examples/*.png`: reference mockups only, not active runtime UI.
- `res://assets/ui/fonts/rpg_ui_pack/*.ttf`: candidate pixel fonts for controlled UI experiments.

Usage rule:
Do not wire these assets into runtime scenes until the visual target is explicitly chosen. Prefer small extractions/icons over replacing Gallicus' wooden/ritual UI language wholesale.
